Title: Omniroute Control Panel
SettingAutoStartDesc: The app starts quietly in the background system tray.
SettingLangDesc: Change the control panel interface language.
DialogQuitMsg:
Are you leaving?

If you exit now, OmniRoute services will be stopped and any ongoing tasks will be interrupted. Please ensure OmniRoute is idle before proceeding.

Do you really want to quit?
DialogStopMsg:
Are you sure you want to stop the OmniRoute service?

Active routings and connections will be terminated.

SettingThemeDesc: Choose interface theme. When System is selected, it follows your browser preference.
